item.title: Huntington Police warn the public about fentanyl disguised as candy following recent drug seizure
item.description: The Huntington Police Department is warning the community after a major drug seizure involving pills designed to look like candy. According to a media release, Huntington Violent Crime Drug Task Force investigators reportedly seized over 900 multi-colored tablets pressed into the shape of a popular cartoon from the Transformers series.

item.title: Attorney General JB McCuskey files lawsuit against Apple alleging the platform allowed the distribution of child sexual abuse material
item.description: Attorney General JB McCuskey has filed a lawsuit against Apple. In the media release announcing the lawsuit, the Attorney General accuses the company of knowingly allowing its iCloud platform to store and distribute child sexual abuse material and failing to take action to stop it.

item.title: Montcalm High School evacuated due to bomb threat
item.description: Rock, WV (WOAY) Mercer County Schools reports Montcalm High School has been evacuated due to a bomb threat. Students, faculty, and staff are safe in the school’s evacuation location. We’ll update this story as we receive further developments.
